name: ESXi Administration Command
summary: Adversaries may abuse ESXi administration services to execute commands on guest machines hosted within an ESXi virtual environment. Persistent background services on ESXi-hosted VMs, such as the VMware Tools Daemon Service, allow for remote management from the ESXi server. strategies.name: Detection Strategy for ESXi Administration Command

analytics.name: Analytic 0646
analytics.guidance: Detects anomalous usage of ESXi Guest Operations APIs such as StartProgramInGuest, ListProcessesInGuest, ListFileInGuest, or InitiateFileTransferFromGuest. Defender perspective focuses on unusual frequency of guest API calls, invocation from unexpected management accounts, or execution outside of business hours. These correlated signals indicate adversarial abuse of ESXi administrative services to run commands on guest VMs.
